title: Chicken Karahi

description: Chicken Karahi is a quintessential Pakistani dish, known for its vibrant flavors and quick preparation in a wok-like karahi. This spicy and aromatic chicken curry, cooked with fresh tomatoes, ginger, green chilies, and a blend of traditional spices, offers a rustic yet incredibly satisfying culinary experience. It is a staple on Pakistani dinner tables, celebrated for its rich, bold taste and succulent chicken pieces.

ingredients.item: Chicken, bone-in, cut into karahi pieces

instructions.title: Sear the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat cooking oil in a large karahi or wok over high heat. Add the chicken pieces and fry until they change color and are lightly browned on all sides, typically 8-10 minutes. This step helps seal in the juices.

instructions.title: Add Aromatics and Spices
instructions.text: Reduce heat to medium. Add the ginger-garlic paste to the chicken and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Then, add red chili powder, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook for another 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning and to infuse the chicken with spices.

instructions.title: Cook with Tomatoes
instructions.text: Add the chopped or pureed tomatoes to the karahi. Cover the karahi and cook on medium-low heat for about 10-12 minutes, or until the tomatoes soften and release their juices. Use the back of your spoon to mash the tomatoes well, creating a thick base.

instructions.title: Introduce Yogurt and Green Chilies
instructions.text: Increase heat to medium. Stir in the whisked plain yogurt and the slit green chilies. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the oil separates from the masala and the chicken is tender. This usually takes about 8-10 minutes.

instructions.title: Finish with Roasted Spices
instructions.text: Add the freshly roasted and crushed cumin seeds, coriander powder, and garam masala powder to the karahi. Mix everything well and cook for 2-3 minutes more, allowing the aromatic spices to fully meld with the chicken and gravy.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Generously garnish the hot Chicken Karahi with fresh julienned ginger and chopped cilantro. Serve immediately with warm naan, roti, or plain rice for an authentic Pakistani meal experience.

tips: For an authentic taste and richer gravy, always use bone-in chicken pieces, as the bones impart more flavor during cooking.
Do not add water to your Karahi. The dish traditionally cooks in its own juices along with the moisture released from the tomatoes and yogurt, creating a thick, robust gravy.
Adjust the amount of green chilies and red chili powder to your personal preference for spice. For a milder version, deseed the green chilies.
